name: cx-goal-one-rule~p3
task: Open the door, then take the box from the other room; try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard clause Existence(door_open) is redundant because the hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) together with the hard Existence(target_picked_up) already forces door_open. Redundant existence clauses are defects (checklist 6). Remove the hard Existence(door_open) clause; keep the hard Precedence and the hard Existence(target_picked_up).

CHANGES REQUIRED: The soft Absence(key_lost) clause forbids the key_lost event at any time, but the task only says “try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.” This is a preference that applies only while the door is closed, not universally. Replace the soft Absence(key_lost) with a soft Precedence(door_open, key_lost) (or an equivalent conditional rule) so that key_lost is only discouraged before the door is opened.

texts: The target box must be picked up at least once.
The door must be opened before the target box is picked up.
Prefer not to lose the key while the door is still closed.
